subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should description-only schema guidance close this issue, or must the message tool also constrain `channel` with a dynamically derived plugin-safe enum?
rationale: The description is a narrow proven correction, but an enum changes model-facing validation and must account for dynamically registered channel plugins; source evidence cannot determine the intended permanent contract.

options.title: Land description first
options.body: Refresh and land the linked description-and-test pull request, then track a dynamic enum separately only if further misuse remains observable.

options.title: Require dynamic enum now
options.body: Expand the linked fix to derive allowed values from the authoritative channel plugin registry and add coverage for bundled and external plugin IDs.

options.title: Keep string-only contract
options.body: Accept prompt and runtime fallback behavior without schema metadata, leaving the reported model confusion unresolved.

recommendation.title: Land description first
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the linked description-and-test pull request, then track a dynamic enum separately only if further misuse remains observable.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed this exact issue and have recent merged history across the message-tool and outbound routing surfaces.
